text: But the next day he spoke to her of his own accord, and his manner was somewhat changed. “Shall you be married within the next four or five months?” he asked. “I don’t know, father,” said Catherine. “It is not very easy for us to make up our minds.” “Put it off, then, for six months, and in the meantime I will take you to Europe. I should like you very much to go.” It gave her such delight, after his words of the day before, to hear that he should “like” her to do something, and that he still had in his heart any of the tenderness of preference, that she gave a little exclamation of joy.
